findings.detail: Credit rows have blank rate fields even though the SOI provides a reference rate and spread, including PIK where applicable.

rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell defect. The extracted AA&D Midco credit row has blank interest_rate and no basis_spread, but raw SOI table 11 row 5 discloses S + 4.75%. The same pattern is independently visible for Titan BW Borrower at table 11 row 12, where S + 5.38% including 2.88% PIK is disclosed while the extracted rate is blank. Thus X02 identifies a real loss of disclosed rate data, not a bad check. Residual risk is limited to whether all 99 flagged rows share the demonstrated mechanism; the cited representative rows decisively establish the flagged batch contains real errors.
